params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: The Premium badge appears on posts that are open to the person looking at them. It should only show when the post is locked for that viewer.

Two causes on main:

- The post page, the featured post on Posts and the reading room ask `isPremium()`, a property of the post (outside the open window of fifteen), so a subscriber who reads the post in full still sees Premium on it.
- The post cards ask `isLockedFor()`, which for a signed-out visitor is true on every post, so the fifteen open posts carry Premium too, although they only ask for a free account.

The brief notes that the fifteen most recent posts are open to everyone, as the Reports page says. On main a signed-out visitor gets the teaser of every post and needs a free account for the full text (a deliberate rule in `Article::isLockedFor`), so the Reports sentence and the rule disagree; which one is right is a question for the owner.

Source: Portal mail:47 (copy update brief for gentells.com, 10 November 2026). The brief itself stays in Portal.
params.title: Premium badge shows on posts the viewer can read
